cases.detail: $dist_uniform with longint or shortint seed variables generates C++ that passes cast temporaries to VL_DIST_UNIFORM(IData&); compilation fails because a non-const lvalue reference cannot bind to an rvalue. IEEE 1800-2023 20.14.2 permits an integral seed variable. Celox passes the unchanged width-conversion case.
